# youtrack_mailbox_integration_settings (Resource)

Manages the instance-wide settings of the YouTrack mailbox integration: the schedule on which YouTrack polls every mailbox. This is a singleton; destroying it restores the default schedule (`0 0/2 * * * ?`, every two minutes).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Poll every mailbox every five minutes.
resource "youtrack_mailbox_integration_settings" "example" {
  cron_expression = "0 0/5 * * * ?"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cron_expression` (String) Quartz cron expression on which YouTrack polls every mailbox, such as `0 0/5 * * * ?` for every five minutes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mailbox integration settings identifier, always `global`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Mailbox integration settings is a singleton resource.
# You can use any value for the import ID (it will be ignored).
terraform import youtrack_mailbox_integration_settings.example global
```
